2:1.sourceText: Καὶ εἰσελθὼν πάλιν εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ δι’ ἡμερῶν ἠκούσθη ὅτι ἐν οἴκῳ ἐστίν.

groups.note: Greek entered is a participle here, rendered by a finite He entered clause in LSV.

unmappedTarget.reason: Bracketed indefinite quantifier supplied with days; N1904 has no separate some.

unmappedTarget.reason: LSV has an intransitive approach verb where N1904 has transitive to bring near; these unlike predicates are left unpaired.
